# Securikey

> Securikey is a family-run, local locksmith and security specialist business covering the entire Isle of Man, with over 30 years of experience.

Securikey provides professional locksmith services island-wide, including automotive key programming, emergency lockout callouts, key cutting, safes, laser engraving, shoe repairs and commercial/domestic security solutions. The business operates two fully equipped mobile workshops and a walk-in shop in Douglas.

## Service Area

Securikey covers the whole Isle of Man, including: Douglas, Onchan, Castletown, Peel, Ramsey, Port Erin, Port St Mary, Laxey, Kirk Michael and Ballasalla.

## Services

- Automotive Locksmith — lost car keys, spare keys, transponder programming, key fobs, vehicle entry for most makes and models.
- Domestic Locksmith — lock changes, repairs, upgrades, home security surveys.
- Commercial Locksmith — access control, master key systems, tailored business security.
- Emergency Callouts — 24-hour emergency response for lockouts and broken locks, anywhere on the island.
- Key Cutting — while-you-wait precision key cutting for homes, vehicles, padlocks and specialist keys.
- Safes — sales, installation, combination changes, opening of domestic and commercial safes.
- Laser Engraving — personalised engraving on gifts, tools, trophies and pet tags.
- Shoe Repairs — heels, soles, stitching and leather restoration.
- Master Key Systems — hierarchical key systems for commercial properties.
